rationale: Caller can embed the figure in notebooks or save to HTML via fig.write_html()
Single interactive scene enables rotate/zoom; the four-view matplotlib layout is replaced by the interactive plotly viewer

requirement: All figure traces are Scatter3d or Cone instances
rationale: Non-3D traces would flatten geometry in the interactive viewer and misrepresent dihedral

requirement: Figure layout.title.text contains the geometry header.name
rationale: Distinguishes saved plots when multiple geometries are compared

requirement: At least one Scatter3d line trace is present
rationale: Missing line traces indicate that surface parsing failed or coordinates were not transferred to the figure

requirement: CG position is rendered as a Scatter3d marker trace
rationale: CG visualization is critical for stability interpretation

requirement: Geometry without a body section plots without error
rationale: Wing-only and body-less models are common and must not raise

requirement: With mirrored surfaces at least 4 Scatter3d line traces are present
rationale: Mirrored surfaces must produce traces on both sides of the symmetry plane

requirement: Geometry with a body section plots without error
rationale: Files with fuselage bodies must not raise during plotting
